affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 175 on August 6, 1942; the general sales category names no employer, product, store, territory, or exact title.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. The general occupation code does not establish a named employer or the later Army-to-OSS sequence.

claims.claim_text: The indexed George C. Brown is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated August 6, 1942; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: A Pennsylvania insurance executive and wartime lieutenant-colonel namesake conflicts with the Army-entry birth-year and grade fields and was rejected, as were other records lacking the private identifier or Box 84 linkage.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, George C. Brown was recorded in the general salesperson occupation category.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official record carries code 175; the official numerical list maps 1-75 to salespersons.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on August 6, 1942; its relation to OSS recruitment remains unknown.
claims.match_notes: No employer, store, product, territory, exact sales title, or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred from the category.

person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 84 for the sales employer and Army-to-OSS chronology.
